titleEn: Inter-Ministerial Prakas No. 321 on the Establishment of the Revenue Budget for 2024 at the Ministry of Public Works and Transport

articles.en: - A revenue budget is hereby established at the Ministry of Public Works and Transport in order to collect the various non-tax revenues in accordance with the applicable regulations. The list of revenue types for which the 2024 revenue budget is established is as follows: - Sub-account 73023, proceeds from the establishment of enterprises, amount [illegible in source]; - Sub-account 73066, revenue from domestic licences, amount [illegible in source]; - Sub-account 73083, revenue from the sale of vehicle registration plates, amount [illegible in source]; - Sub-account 73084, revenue from the registration of vehicles and vessels, amount [illegible in source]; - Sub-account 73085, revenue from the issue of driving licences of all categories, amount [illegible in source]; - Sub-account 73087, proceeds from product quality inspection and compliance with standards, amount [illegible in source]; - Sub-account 74092, fines and pecuniary penalties, amount [illegible in source]; total, amount [illegible in source].
- The maximum amount authorised to be retained in the petty cash account shall not exceed 2,000,000 riels (two million riels).
- Any provisions the content of which is contrary to this inter-ministerial prakas shall be considered null and void.

- The Director of the Cabinet, the Secretary-General, the Government Delegate in charge as Director-General of the General Department of the National Treasury, the Government Delegate in charge as Director-General of the General Department of State Property and Non-Tax Revenue, the Inspector-General, and the heads of all relevant units under the authority of the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Ministry of Public Works and Transport shall be responsible for implementing this inter-ministerial prakas from the date of signature onwards.
